name: ca.regmap/regmap
title: RegMap Canada
description: Canadian internal trade barriers, licence moves, reform scoreboard and regulations, with sources.

tools.name: search_barriers
tools.description: Find interprovincial trade barriers in RegMap's inventory by occupation, product or sector (e.g. 'nurse', 'wine shipping', 'trucking'), optionally for a province pair (from -> to) or one jurisdiction. Returns plain-language question, short answer, who imposes it, and the regmap.ca URL to cite. For verified province-by-province barriers with from and to, also returns the status for that move.

query.description: Occupation, product, activity or sector in plain words.

from.description: Origin jurisdiction (where the person, product or firm comes from).

jurisdiction.description: A single jurisdiction to filter by, instead of a pair.

include_historical.description: Also return removed or resolved barriers (default false).

tools.name: get_barrier
tools.description: Full record for one internal trade barrier: summary, legal basis, the regulations it cites, official and study sources, review date, and for verified barriers the answer in every province and territory. Pass from and to for a province-pair answer.

from.description: Jurisdiction code (CA = federal, BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL, YT, NT, NU) or its name.

to.description: Jurisdiction code (CA = federal, BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL, YT, NT, NU) or its name.

tools.name: licence_move
tools.description: For a licensed occupation (e.g. registered nurse, practical nurse, electrician, teacher) moving to another province or territory: whether the licence is recognized, the regulator, steps, published fees, timeline, added requirements and posted CFTA exceptions, each tied to the regulator's own page, with the checked date and the regmap.ca URL to cite. Omit `to` for every destination at a glance; omit `occupation` to list what is covered.

occupation.description: Occupation in plain words or its slug, e.g. 'registered nurse', 'LPN', 'electrician'.

from.description: Province or territory the person is licensed in now (filters origin-specific notes and exceptions).

tools.name: scoreboard
tools.description: Every published intergovernmental internal trade commitment against each of the 14 governments: done, in progress, missed or not committed, with deadlines and the official source per cell. Filter by jurisdiction for one government's record, or pass a commitment id for its full row.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (CA = federal, BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL, YT, NT, NU) or its name.

commitment.description: Commitment id from a previous scoreboard result.

tools.name: search_regulations
tools.description: Search RegMap's catalogue of more than 25,000 federal, provincial and territorial acts and regulations (titles from official legislation portals) by keyword, jurisdiction, topic category or sector. Returns titles, citations, the official text link and the regmap.ca URL to cite.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (CA = federal, BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, QC, NB, NS, PE, NL, YT, NT, NU) or its name.

tools.name: get_regulation
tools.description: One catalogue instrument by slug: title, citation, jurisdiction, enabling act, currency date, official text link, regmap.ca URL, and any internal trade barriers that cite it.

tools.name: reform_status
tools.description: Dated, officially sourced internal trade reforms since 2025 (laws passed or in force, regulations, agreements, exception removals, mutual recognition), filtered by jurisdiction, status or keyword, plus upcoming dates. Each event has its regmap.ca URL and official source.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code, or ALL for FPT-wide events only.

since.description: Only events on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: What changed in RegMap's barrier inventory at recent refreshes: barriers added, amended, removed or restored.

days.description: How many refresh dates to return (default 5).

tools.name: compare_provinces
tools.description: Rank the 13 provinces and territories by how many business-relevant acts and regulations they have for one sector (regulatory surface, not burden), with the federal count for reference.

include_economy_wide.description: Also count rules that bind every business (default false).

tools.name: regmap_overview
tools.description: Coverage counts, freshness dates, and the valid jurisdiction codes, barrier topics, regulation categories and sectors.
